Name: Lumisteria Treasures For Metal Detector
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds several vanilla items as items you can find with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9843]Coin Collector[/url]'s mod metal detector.

You can find some trash items, artifacts, various fishing items (spinner, magnets) and rarely, some metal bars. If you like searching things in the maps and discover hidden treasures, consider this mod !

The framework ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9843]Coin Collector[/url]) allows you to configure the chance each map have treasures and the number of them, don't hesitate to tweak the numbers so you get a balance you like !
If you want more things to find, also consider [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9844]Yoba Coins[/url] Pack, by Aedenthorn.

Thanks to Aedenthorn for the framework !
